selected_models.Q4-2: P3 rolling histogram gradient boosting plus midnight-only LP
selected_models.Q4-3: P2 rolling ridge plus revisions at 00/06/12/18

comparison_basis.common_supply_and_storage: reuse frozen arrays and planners from 20260912-three-candidates-v1
comparison_basis.future_information: no future actual price, load or PV in executable candidates; actual future price is allowed only in the explicitly labelled infeasible information benchmark
comparison_basis.terminal_value: 0.9 times attachment-1 midnight price in rolling planning; terminal inventory is separately valued in V06

selection_rules.Q4-2: report cost, high-price error, emergency use, end storage and setting reversals; remove unsupported features and weaken the claim if nearby settings reverse selection frequently
selection_rules.Q4-3: prefer a simplification only if emergency kWh does not increase and its cost concession is no larger than the already rejected P3 edge of 2273.23 yuan; otherwise retain the selected full P2
selection_rules.information_value: attribute only the difference from a same-permission same-supply control; do not add overlapping release contributions
selection_rules.risk: retain adverse months/days and finite observed-block limits; do not claim cross-year robustness
